A LITTLE PERSPECTIVE

Meet your planet.

WorldScope brings satellite imagery, real terrain and the stories of places together in one interactive atlas.

Move aroundDrag with one finger or the mouse.
Get closerPinch, scroll, or use + and −.
Change perspectiveTwo-finger drag or Ctrl + drag to tilt.
Discover a placeTap a marker or anywhere on land. Submit a search for more locations.

Sources & imagery

3D engine: CesiumJS (Apache 2.0). Satellite and elevation: Esri and its data partners; imagery dates and detail vary by location. Night: NASA GIBS / VIIRS Black Marble, 2016 composite, approximately 500 m resolution. Borders: Natural Earth, public domain; boundaries are approximate and may be disputed. Clouds: historical NASA imagery via WebGL Earth, illustrative rather than live. Place information and photos: Wikipedia / Wikimedia; articles CC BY-SA, photos retain their individual licenses. Search fallback: © OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim.

Internet access is required for maps and live place information. Public services can be unavailable or rate-limited. Saved places stay on this device. This is an exploration tool, not a navigation service.
